scope: The local live-feedback recorder never persists raw console/page-error text, even through the legacy diagnostic-text option. Pattern-based redaction removes recognizable email, phone, common token/password key-value formats and sensitive-label context from diagnostics and interaction metadata. Optional Chromium screenshots additionally mask matching rendered text and grouped sensitive demographic/credential labels.

acceptance.raw_console_page_error_text_not_stored: PASS - Recorder test passes with diagnostic_text=True and confirms output contains fingerprints only, without message text.
acceptance.recognizable_sensitive_metadata_redacted: PASS - Unit tests verify synthetic email/token values are removed from diagnostics and interaction metadata; sensitive labels and explicit interaction context redact answer text.
acceptance.visual_sensitive_text_masked: PASS - Headless Chromium pixel checks verify opaque masks cover synthetic email text and a sensitive demographic label/answer group, alongside standard controls and data-sensitive regions.
acceptance.raw_dom_trace_absent: PASS - Existing focused session test prevents tracing and confirms no trace archive is written.
acceptance.issue_requirement_complete: false - Unclassifiable private values and text baked into images/canvas cannot be detected reliably by this pattern-based implementation.

test_first_red.observation: The system Python lacked Playwright. Under the repository virtual environment, the new tests then failed because the redaction helper and text masks were absent; after implementation, a pixel acceptance assertion was corrected to sample the final screenshot rather than temporary DOM marker attributes. Final focused tests pass.

limitations: Regex-based redaction can over-mask ordinary content and cannot recognize every arbitrary private value; screenshot review remains required before sharing.
Text embedded in images/canvas and non-DOM visual content is not inspected.
Issue #181 / MJ-REQ-180 remains OPEN/PARTIAL for remaining debug-data surfaces outside this live-feedback recorder.
The full repository suite, frontend build, PostgreSQL/Docker workflows and hosted verification were not run.
